_comment: The blog (card #361). One template renders every post (essay-page.js, css/blog.css); a post never carries its own styles. Per post: the facts below, the body in essays/<slug>.html, and img/posts/<slug>/ (image.json -> python tools/render_images.py img/posts/<slug>). Read time, h2 ids, the TOC and related posts are computed by build.js. type is one of Field report, Playbook, Field notes, Column. dek 155 characters max, title 60 max (verify.js).
